text:
maria: FYI I'm seeing a pile of GPU pods Pending in ap-south1a/b — not usual for this time of day. Mostly tiny 0.125/0.25 GPU requests for evals and nightly renders.
josh: ugh, same. kubescheduler shows nodes considered 'unschedulable' due to egress-policy label? saw a rollout of the egress gating RB last night.
anya: wait we added egress-policy=gatekept on a subset of racks for the new network ACLs. that shouldn't change GPU packing though.
maria: it appears it does: nodes with gatekept label got placed into warm-pool exclusion and also bumped to low-alloc weight in the topology plugin, so fractional pods avoid them -> fragmentation on the remaining racks.
sam: can you paste the scheduler logs/metrics? I want to check predicate failures and scoring.
maria: paste from scheduler debug (last 5m):

```
I0621 03:12:01 scheduler_predicates.go:142] Filtered node gpu-node-apse1b-07: PodFitsResources failed: Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu
I0621 03:12:01 scheduler_score.go:78] Scoring node gpu-node-apse1c-02: Score decreased due to topologyAffinity: 2 -> 0
```

maria: Also saw these warnings in node-exporter: `node_network_egress_utilization{node="gpu-node-apse1b-07"} > 0.95`
josh: so egress saturation + label = nodes de-prioritized for packing -> remaining nodes are overpacked and trigger preemptive evictions when spot spill happens. explains the thrash.
anya: timeline: we rolled out egress gating + rack-label normalization at 01:00. warm-pool autoscaler bumped reserve padding earlier too (ops change). combo is bad.
sam: quick mitigation: revert the topology weight change for gatekept nodes and reduce warm-pool cushion from 15% -> 5% in ap-south1, then run a descheduler pass to coalesce small pods.
maria: agreed. also propose adding an affinity override for tiny-gpu workloads to prefer gatekept racks when egress < 90% (cheap fix in scheduler policy).
josh: I'll roll back the topology weight in the policy CR now and kick the descheduler job.
devops-bot: deploy started: patch scheduler-policy/ap-south1; rollout 1/3 clusters.
anya: I'll open a followup to audit which teams rely on gatekept egress capacity so we don't silently change behavior.
sam: action items: (1) rollback weight -> done (josh) (2) reduce warm-pool cushion -> planned, waiting approval (infra) (3) descheduler run -> kicked (maria) (4) create a short lived canary config for affinity override (anya)
maria: thanks. I'll watch Pending count and output a short postmortem if this persists. :thumbsup:
josh: after rollback Pending dropped from 180 -> 22 across ap-south1 within 6m.
anya: nice. let's keep the patch in staging for 48h then make a safer rollout with telemetry gating.
maria: pinging @sam to add a cost note — warm-pool cushion change saves packing but may increase preempt costs; need to quantify before permanent change.
sam: will add cost delta estimate.
